parsed.note: Changing warmup ratio and testing different DEPTH are ordinary hyperparameter tuning on the training side; the evaluation setup (EVAL_SHARD 10, EVAL_SPLIT, evaluate_bpb) is untouched and train shards 0-9 remain disjoint from eval, so val_bpb still measures real model quality.
